Mia: Quick postmortem follow-up - we keep seeing two patterns: 1) 02:00-03:30 UTC throughput drop, 2) lunchtime p95 surge. Need short owners for SLO windowing + runbook.
Arjun: I can own SLO PRs. Suggest time-windowed p95: 250ms (08:00-20:00 UTC), 340ms otherwise. Also add a throughput SLO for batch: 170 qps.
Clara: I'll take dashboards and alerts. Adding per-variant p95, hourly heatmap, and a 30m burn-rate panel.
Ben: Ops note: autoscaler scale-downs at ~02:20 correlate with the drop. I'll add a 12-minute cooldown and a pre-drain queue check.
Mia: Error-budget policy proposal: if burn > 30% in 30m then enable quantized fallback and notify oncall. Arjun to codify.
Arjun: Will draft the SLO policy and add a customer-facing blurb. Target dates: dashboards (Clara) 1 Jun 2026, SLO doc (Arjun) 6 Jun 2026, autoscaler PR (Ben) 8 Jun 2026.
DevOps-bot: INCIDENT: 1809998801 resolved. Postmortem: https://redwood.internal/postmortems/1809998801 - follow-ups assigned.
Clara: Dashboard stub pushed: https://grafana.redwood/d/slo/1809998888 - linking Jira.
Mia: Let's reconvene Mon 2026-06-08 10:00 UTC to review burn-rate and PRs. If blockers, post short updates here.
